You only need about a dime size amount of the product so scoop that out (please wash your hand anytime you are about to touch your face or dip into jars) then keep the product on your fingertips and rub both hands (fingertips on each hand) together to warm up the product. This will help with sheering out the foundation. Then start applying on the dryer parts of your face (usually the cheeks and forehead) apply by PRESSING the moisturizer in and NOT RUBBING. By pressing you are pushing the moisturizer into your skin instead of leaving some sitting on the top. After you have applied to those place you will find you have just a small amount left on your hand. That is when you will press into the Oiler parts of your face which is for most people the T-Zone.
